ينتزعون (form VIII)
# يَنْتَزِعُونَ (yantaziʕūna) /jan.ta.zi.ʕuː.na/: third-person masculine plural non-past active indicative of اِنْتَزَعَ (intazaʕa)
# يُنْتَزَعُونَ (yuntazaʕūna) /jun.ta.za.ʕuː.na/: third-person masculine plural non-past passive indicative of اِنْتَزَعَ (intazaʕa)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
